column1: # The project-rules glob dialect, as one table both readers are proven
# and the generated engine's ERE translation.
# Columns, separated by one tab: pattern, path, expected.
#   expected is `match`, `no-match`, or `invalid` (the pattern is outside
#   the dialect, so no reader delivers a rule using it; path is one the
#   pattern would name if it were accepted, so a reader that took it would
# Paths are relative to the checkout root, `/` between segments.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
# a directory is named after `**/`, since Antigravity matches against the
# absolute path; `**` spans any number of whole segments, none included
# a pattern with no `/` names a file at any depth
# `?` is one character inside one segment
# `[…]` is one character of a set or a range
# literals are exact, case and spaces included
